name: Spherical Harmonics Irradiance Encoding
definition: An approach to encode full spherical irradiance information using spherical harmonics, the most generic method to encode directional surface lighting.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Irradiance Encoding represents directional surface lighting using standard orthogonal spherical harmonic bases to model irradiance changes with surface normal, distinguishing itself from exponentiated variants by focusing on surface orientation rather than volumetric transport.
